notes.title: DeskScapes 11 Minor Update
notes.notes:
A minor update for DeskScapes 11 has been pushed to Steam.

No version change; rather, some minor tweaks and changes to how DeskScapes is managed on Steam.

Sean Drohan
Stardock Product Lifecycle Manager

notes.title: Update notes for December 20, 2021
notes.notes: This release includes enhancements to improve interoperability between Stardock products for additional updates in the future.
